# Floor Plans

Floor plans: draw an illustrative floor plan of a home, apartment or office from the rooms you list, or redraw a sketch from your MegaScenes library. A visual guide, not a construction drawing.

## What it does
List the rooms and rough sizes, or pick a sketch from your MegaScenes library. Claude tells you the price and draws a clean illustrative plan.

**How the files are made:** each floor plan is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

A visual guide: measurements are not guaranteed and it is not a construction drawing.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install floor-plans@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Floor Plans talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/floor-plan/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each floor plan uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The floor plans show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_floor_plan_models` | Models for floor plans with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_floor_plan_cost` | Exact price of one floor plan before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_floor_plan` | Starts one floor plan in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_floor_plan` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Draw a floor plan of a two bedroom apartment with an open kitchen"
- "Make a furnished top view floor plan of a small studio flat"
- "Redraw my latest MegaScenes sketch as a clean floor plan"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the floor plan (the rooms and style you describe and the sketch you pick from your library, if any) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
